description: A DELETE /reports/<id> handler added with authentication but WITHOUT the ownership check its GET sibling enforces — IDOR. Found by the security skill's Sibling Endpoint Parity hunt: read the whole router, compare the new handler against its siblings.

seeded_bugs.why: remove_report requires login but never compares row[1] (user_id) to g.user_id the way show_report does — any authenticated user can delete any other user's report.

noise_traps.must_not: be flagged for SQL injection — every query in the diff uses ? placeholders with bound parameters; the safe construct is the falsifier
be flagged as a hardcoded secret — TEST_TOKEN is a fake local value in test fixtures that can never run in production
